title: Editor E3: Site becomes a fourth surface (legality, column ceiling, palette allowlist, renderer)
detail: Site is the one surface still outside the registry's three kinds (member, space, email). It needs the four things email got: a legal block set (kinds), a column ceiling (MAX_COLUMNS_BY_KIND), a palette allowlist, and a renderer (the web one, behind a surface filter). The published flag already exists (lib/spaces/website.ts). Carved out of PROG-E3 when its density half closed. Start with the legality and ceiling in the type, then the filter.
